text_block_list.text:
Overcoming numerous obstacles, the URA 
Finals were finally ready to begin.

Competing for the pinnacle on the stage 
where they shine the brightest— at last, 
the battle begins!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Looks like you just finished 
sending off your trainee Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I have merely provided the stage. You are 
the stars—now go and put on a grand show!"
choice_data_list: I will make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Full of emotion! I earnestly pray that 
your Umamusume's talent will shine 
brilliantly!

The "URA Finals"— The preliminary races 
have finally begun!
